name: Shinonome Aoi
source:
Hobbies: Cooking
Skills: Cooking
Weakness: Panics easily
Magic type: Magic absorption (Bonds)

The protagonist who is the only male possessing magic abilities in the world. Despite this fact, he is not able to control his magic well and can only use a very small portion of it. In order to train his magic and because the [url=/c45472]principal[/url] took an interest in him, Aoi is transferred to Mikuni Academy for Witches.

Has above average grades and excellent reflexes, and is an all-around person in housework. However, he has a tad dull and serious personality but at times is pretty calm. Aoi has a strong will and does no give up easily despite his low magic potential.
